text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Her race schedule is... unknown?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean?
Do you truly not understand?

"Crimson Nova's previous race was the international GⅠ held in Dubai this spring.
After that race concluded—"

Ever since returning to the country, there has been no movement whatsoever.
Most likely, she's searching for the right timing to restart, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If I don't know which race she's running in,
I can't even challenge her to a match...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: This is quite troubling...

Is she trying to keep her rivals in the dark about her moves?
If so, it would be difficult even for a Trainer to find out.

A midsummer mystery.
Which race will the crimson flames target next?
While walking alone along the night beach, lost in thought...
Excuse me, you over there.

"You don't have to be so scared~.
It's not like I'm a ghost.
More importantly..."

Wanna buy some intel, huh? Some juicy info?
I'll give ya a special discount~

Called out by a suspicious voice, I peek behind the shade of a rock.
And there—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, the name's Transcend.
You're a Trainer around here, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The summer sale is on right now. So,
care to gather some intel with me?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll offer you any scoop at a special discount price.
Whaddya say?

Transcend. I've heard the rumors.
The informant Umamusume working
behind the scenes at Tracen Academy.

She has an information network woven across the entire globe,
and they say there's no secret she can't get.
Perhaps she could...
choice_data_list: Do you know anything about Crimson Nova's movements?
Do you know anything about Crimson Nova's movements?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Crimson Nova, huh.
Hmm, hmm, hold on just a moment."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I checked in with my sources.
How's this look?

Written there was her upcoming race schedule.
According to the list...

"JBC Classic" in November.
"Champions Cup" in early December.
"Tokyo Daishoten" in late December.

"It might only be the tentative plan for now,
but knowing this much is plenty good."
choice_data_list: That really helped, thank you! What do I owe you for the info?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah. Let's just say it's on the house
for today.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, if you ever come across
any useful info in the future, be sure to share it with me~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I mainly run on dirt, so any dirt info is super welcome. Cool?"
choice_data_list: 'Kay! I'll definitely return the favor someday!

text_block_list.text: The walk had yielded an immense payoff. And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: T-That's incredible intel. As expected of Transcend-san...!
I immediately spoke with Furioso and shared the information.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The JBC Classic,
the Champions Cup,
and the Tokyo Daishoten..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: That means we get to compete against each other in GⅠ races three times within this year.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I want to gain more experience
and catch up even a little bit.

Furioso is still in the Classic Class.
Although she's already eligible to enter races
against Senior Class racers, her body is still growing.

"The gap between us and Crimson Nova is vast.
However, if we continue to grow in both mind and body—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that we understand that,
please start the training.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I must become much, much stronger!
So that tragedy never repeats itself.
"We understood the opposing side's movements. All that was left was to relentlessly prepare for the match."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Our opponent is strong. But we have
a weapon that's uniquely ours. And that is—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
("Frustration"!
I will never forget the frustration of that day,
when the Funabashi Umamusume were utterly defeated.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I'll turn this frustration——
into boundless power!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"They are an Umamusume just like me. In that case, I will strike a blow without fail!
Haaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer!!

Furioso earnestly and wholeheartedly pushed through
the endless repetitions of steady distance running.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Free time, is it...?
Still, I would rather not spend it idly.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like to do something that'll help with my racing too, though.
...Trainer, do you have any recommendations?"

"Something that's also useful for racing...
What I want her to do for a change of pace is..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Soccer on the beach, is it? As for soccer,
I have played a fair amount of it before.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Needless to say, Funabashi has
schools famous for their soccer teams.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's find an opponent and have a match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you, Furioso-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please~.

Soccer-loving horse girls began to gather.
Among them were the model class representative Narita Top Road and the totally ordinary horse girl Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then let the match begin, kickoff!
Taaaaahhhhhh!!

Narita Top Road immediately kicks the ball out with power.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not moving...?
I thought it'd chase after the ball right away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be reeled in
by bait right in front of my eyes so easily."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(First, take a good look at the whole pitch.
And then—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A counter!
Right now! Taaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! No way!?
Such insight...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is Funabashi soccer.
Always assess the situation calmly!

Furioso delivered a truly composed
and commanding performance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san, I was truly moved.
Even though today was just for fun...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'd love for us to have a real, serious match as fellow Umamusume someday.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do it.
Next, instead of the sandy beach—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: At the National Stadium!
Feeling like a full-fledged soccer player... Furioso built up her leg strength with some sand soccer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Taking time to play an instrument, huh. Actually, I have played a musical instrument a little bit before.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Funabashi has schools famous for their brass bands,
after all. Now then, allow me to show you.
And so, the musical instrument Furioso brought was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is it. Cymbals.
choice_data_list: You don't mean brass instruments or something, do you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I've tried my hand at brass and woodwind instruments before,
but I couldn't really get the hang of playing them...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Then please start the music.
I'll drum along to it.
Brass band music plays from the smartphone. And at the end of the song—
(BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That's all. Adding just one note tightens up the end
and changes the whole impression."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do it once more.
Please play it from the beginning again."

Furioso waits patiently for the long song to end.
And so, her perseverance was forged.
(BANG!)
